paper.title: Quiet-STaR: Language Models Can Teach Themselves to Think Before Speaking

result.summary: 本文提出 Quiet-STaR，将 STaR 从问答数据集推广到任意文本，让语言模型在每个 token 处生成内部理由以解释未来文本，从而改进预测 [abstract]。方法上采用 tokenwise 并行采样、可学习的思考起止 token 以及扩展的 teacher-forcing 技术 [abstract]。在 Mistral 7B 上继续预训练后，模型在 GSM8K 和 CommonsenseQA 上取得零样本提升，并在自然文本的困难 token 上观察到困惑度改善 [abstract]。作者认为这朝着更通用、可扩展的推理学习迈出了一步 [abstract]。

research_question.text: 论文要解决的问题是：STaR 等方法依赖人工整理的问答数据集来学习推理，这限制了理由的规模和泛化性，因为高质量问答数据集只能覆盖推理任务的一个子集 [S1.p2]。因此作者希望让语言模型从大规模互联网文本中学习生成有助于推断未来文本的推理，从而利用语言中存在的多样任务 [S1.p2]。

evidence.quote: Yet, training from curated QA datasets limits the scale and generalizability of the rationales.
QA datasets, especially high-quality ones, require thoughtful curation and will inherently only ever cover a subset of reasoning tasks.
we train an LM to generate reasoning that helps it infer future text from a large internet text corpus.
As a result, we allow the LM to learn from the diverse tasks present in language.

method.text: Quiet-STaR 是 STaR 的推广：语言模型在每个 token 处生成理由来解释未来文本，并据此改进预测 [abstract]。为应对生成续写的计算成本、模型初始不知道如何生成或使用内部思考、以及需要预测超出单个下一 token 等挑战，作者提出 tokenwise 并行采样算法、指示思考开始与结束的可学习 token，以及扩展的 teacher-forcing 技术 [abstract]。与 STaR 一样，方法利用模型已有的推理能力生成理由，并用基于 REINFORCE 的奖励训练模型 [S1.p2]。

evidence.quote: We present Quiet-STaR , a generalization of STaR in which LMs learn to generate rationales at each token to explain future text, improving their predictions.
we propose a tokenwise parallel sampling algorithm, using learnable tokens indicating a thought’s start and end, and an extended teacher-forcing technique.
as in STaR, we leverage the LM’s pre-existing reasoning ability to generate rationales and train the LM on them with a REINFORCE-based reward.

experiments.text: 实验以 Mistral 7B 基础版本为起点 [S5.p1]。大部分实验在 OpenWebMath 上训练，作者预期该语料包含更高密度的受益于推理的 token [S5.p2]。同时也在 C4 上评估，使用 16 个思考 token 和 4 个真实 token 的前瞻，其余设置相同 [S5.SS1.p2]。评估包括 CommonsenseQA 和 GSM8K 上的零样本推理能力，以及思考 token 影响的分布 [S5.p1]。

evidence.quote: We conduct all of our experiments starting with the base version of Mistral 7B.
We perform most of our experiments by training on OpenWebMath, a crawl that emphasizes more technical webpages.
We also evaluate Quiet-STaR on C4, a widely used LM pretraining corpus with more diverse text, and again show significant albeit smaller benefits.
we train Mistral 7B with 16 thought tokens and 4 true tokens ahead and otherwise the same setup.

We evaluate 1) whether Quiet-STaR improves a language model’s ability to directly predict answers in datasets that require reasoning; and, 2) the distribution of impacts resulting from thinking tokens.

findings.text: 在 OpenWebMath 上继续预训练后，Quiet-STaR 在 CommonsenseQA 上相比基础语言模型提升 10.9%，在 GSM8K 上提升 5.0%，且性能随理由中 token 数量增加而持续提升 [S5.SS1.p1]。在 C4 上训练也带来提升，但幅度较小：GSM8K 从 5.9% 到 8.1%，CommonsenseQA 从 36.3% 到 42.6% [S5.SS1.p2]。这些下游结果验证了在通用文本数据上训练模型预测字里行间的潜台词可以提升其推理能力，即使未在这些数据集上显式训练 [S5.SS1.p4]。此外，在零样本思维链设置下，8 样本多数投票准确率从 40.6% 提升到 47.7% [S5.SS3.p1]。

evidence.quote: On CommonsenseQA, we find that Quiet-STaR improves performance by 10.9% compared to the base language model.
Similarly, on GSM8K, Quiet-STaR results in a 5.0% boost over the base model, and once again, performance scales with the length of the rationales generated during Quiet-STaR training.
training with Quiet-STaR on C4 also improves performance on GSM8K ( $5.9\%\rightarrow 8.1\%$) and CommonsenseQA ( $36.3\%\rightarrow 42.6\%$) but by a smaller margin.

these downstream results validate that training a language model to predict the subtext between the lines of general text data can substantially improve its reasoning capabilities, even on datasets it was not explicitly trained on.
The majority vote accuracy over 8 samples (cot-maj@8) increases from 40.6% to 47.7% with Quiet-STaR, as evaluated on a sample of 128 GSM8K test items.

limitations.text: 作者指出，为解决元学习挑战而做了一些简化，例如尚不清楚这些技术从零开始训练模型时是否有效，且只将 Quiet-STaR 应用于 70 亿参数模型 [S6.p1]。Quiet-STaR 带来显著开销，在生成每个额外 token 前要生成许多 token [S6.p2]。当前实现不支持动态预测何时生成或结束理由，作者认为这是一个自然的扩展方向 [S6.p2]。此外，无法知道模型用语言表达的推理是否准确反映其内部处理（即忠实性），且若模型发现有害或有偏的推理模式有用，也没有防护措施 [Sx1.p1]。

evidence.quote: it would be valuable to understand whether these techniques work when a model is trained from scratch.
We have also only applied Quiet-STaR to a 7 billion parameter model, albeit a powerful one.
Quiet-STaR results in a substantial overhead, generating many tokens before generating every additional token.
In the current implementation we do not support dynamically predicting when to generate, or end, a rationale.
it is impossible to know that the reasoning expressed by the model in language accurately represents the internal processing of the model (i.e., faithfulness).
there are no safeguards against harmful or biased reasoning patterns if the model finds them useful.
